{{Quote|About midday the day we left, Nerrik tried to turn back but Haze would have none of it. We couldn't have Nerrik telling Wilkes.|One of Sylas Wilkes's men|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Nerrik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal in the employ of [[Sylas Wilkes]] who was one of fifteen men tasked with guarding a shipment of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and a [[Tulak Hord's artifact (Tatooine)|Sith artifact]] for their boss on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, the artifact drove the group mad, and they fled into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] with the blasters and the artifacts. Nerrik tried to turn back about midday on the first day, but was stopped by [[Haze]] and forced to continue to at gunpoint. The group discussed what to do with him at nightfall, but they were attacked by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] and Nerrik was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the natives.
